sections.title: 1. Policy Summary
content: {business_name} provides {service_type}. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, when we share it, and which rights are available to users.
This document is generated from a structured questionnaire. It should be reviewed and completed with business-specific legal advice before publication.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
content: - **Company** means {business_name}.
- **Service** means the {service_type} operated by {business_name}.
- **Website** means {website_url_or_placeholder}.
- **Personal Data** means information that identifies or can reasonably identify a person.
- **Country** means {country}.

subsections.title: 3.1 E-Commerce Operations
content: We process customer account, order, shipping, billing, and transaction-related information to sell products, fulfill orders, manage returns, and comply with tax and accounting obligations.

subsections.title: 3.2 Blog and Content Publishing
content: We process subscriber, reader, comment, and analytics information to publish content, distribute updates, moderate discussions, and improve editorial operations.

subsections.title: 3.3 SaaS and Account Services
content: We process account, authentication, service usage, and support information to deliver hosted software services, secure accounts, troubleshoot issues, and administer subscriptions.

subsections.title: 3.4 Mobile Application Operations
content: We process mobile device, app usage, and diagnostic data to provide core application functionality, maintain reliability, and improve user experience.

subsections.title: 3.5 Nonprofit and Donation Operations
content: We process donor, volunteer, supporter, and campaign information to administer programs, coordinate outreach, and maintain records required for governance and reporting.

subsections.title: 4.1 Personal Information
content: We collect information such as names, email addresses, account identifiers, postal addresses, and similar contact information when you provide it to us.

subsections.title: 4.2 Financial Information
content: We collect or receive payment-related information necessary to process transactions. The exact payment data handled depends on the payment providers and payment flow used by the business.

subsections.title: 4.3 Fiscal and Invoicing Information
content: We may collect tax, billing, invoicing, or regulatory information such as taxpayer identifiers, billing names, legal entity information, or invoice-related transaction records where required for accounting, tax, or legal compliance.

subsections.title: 4.4 Identity and Verification Information
content: We may collect identification or verification-related data where necessary to prevent fraud, verify commercial transactions, process regulated services, or comply with legal obligations.

subsections.title: 4.5 Usage and Diagnostic Data
content: We collect technical and behavioral information such as IP address, browser type, pages viewed, session timestamps, referring pages, and device diagnostics.

subsections.title: 4.6 Cookies and Similar Technologies
content: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, understand usage patterns, maintain sessions, and support security or analytics features.

subsections.title: 4.7 Location Information
content: If enabled for the service, we may process coarse or precise location information to provide location-aware functionality, security monitoring, or region-specific experiences.

sections.title: 5. How We Use Information
content: We use personal information to provide and maintain the service, authenticate users, process transactions, respond to support requests, communicate about updates, monitor performance, protect the service, and comply with legal obligations.

subsections.title: 5.1 Contractual Fulfillment
content: We process information where necessary to perform a contract with users or customers, including order processing, service delivery, account administration, returns, support, and related communications.

subsections.title: 5.2 Consent-Based Processing
content: We may process certain information based on consent, such as marketing communications, optional cookies, location permissions, or other features that users actively enable.

subsections.title: 5.3 Legal Obligations
content: We may process information where necessary to comply with tax, accounting, invoicing, consumer protection, anti-fraud, or other legal and regulatory obligations.

subsections.title: 5.4 Legitimate Interests
content: We may process certain information based on legitimate interests such as service security, fraud prevention, product improvement, limited business analytics, or operational continuity, provided such interests do not override applicable privacy rights.

sections.title: 6. Regional Legal Bases and Privacy Rights

subsections.title: 6.1 GDPR and UK GDPR
content: Where GDPR or UK GDPR applies, we rely on one or more of the following legal bases: performance of a contract, consent, compliance with legal obligations, protection of vital interests, public tasks where relevant, and legitimate interests that are not overridden by data protection rights.
Affected individuals may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, object to processing, and request portability of their personal information, subject to applicable legal limits.

subsections.title: 6.2 California Privacy Rights
content: Where California privacy law applies, residents may request disclosure of categories and specific pieces of personal information collected, request deletion subject to exceptions, request correction where applicable, and opt out of certain sharing or sale activities where required by law.

subsections.title: 6.3 Canadian Privacy Rights
content: Where Canadian privacy law applies, individuals may request access to personal information under our control, request corrections, withdraw consent where legally permitted, and submit complaints to the appropriate supervisory authority.

subsections.title: 6.4 Australian Privacy Rights
content: Where Australian privacy law applies, individuals may request access to their personal information, request correction, and submit complaints about handling practices.

subsections.title: 6.5 Argentina Privacy Rights
content: Where Argentina privacy law applies, individuals may exercise access, rectification, update, and deletion rights under Law 25.326. Consent may be withdrawn where processing depends on consent, subject to legal limits and legitimate retention requirements.

Requests relating to access, rectification, update, or deletion may be submitted through the contact channels listed in this policy. Where appropriate, we may request reasonable information to verify identity and protect third-party data.

Where processing involves consumer relationships, accounts, billing, or operational history, we may retain limited records for as long as needed to satisfy legal, contractual, tax, accounting, security, or fraud-prevention obligations.
Data subjects may also submit complaints to the Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP) where they consider their rights have not been properly addressed.

subsections.title: 6.6 Global or Custom Jurisdiction Review
content: This policy was generated for a business operating under a global or custom jurisdiction profile. Generic privacy rights language has been included, but local legal requirements should be reviewed manually for each country or region where the service is offered.
Individuals may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to processing of personal information depending on local law.

sections.title: 7. Sharing and Service Providers
content: We share personal information only where necessary to operate the service, fulfill transactions, support business operations, comply with law, protect rights, or with user direction or consent.

subsections.title: 7.1 Analytics Providers
content: We use analytics providers to measure usage, improve product performance, understand feature adoption, and support operational reporting.

subsections.title: 7.2 Advertising Partners
content: We may share identifiers, cookie data, or audience signals with advertising partners to measure campaigns, deliver ads, or suppress audiences where legally permitted.

subsections.title: 7.3 Payment Processors
content: Payments are handled through one or more third-party processors. Those providers are responsible for storing and protecting payment credentials under their own privacy and security controls.

subsections.title: 7.4 Shipping and Fulfillment Partners
content: We may share names, delivery addresses, order identifiers, contact details, and shipping-related instructions with carriers, couriers, fulfillment centers, or logistics providers to complete delivery, manage returns, and support order-related operations.

subsections.title: 7.5 PayPal-Only Payments
content: Where payments are handled exclusively through PayPal, we rely on PayPal to process payment credentials and do not store full payment card details on our own systems.

subsections.title: 7.6 Cloud Hosting and Infrastructure
content: We use cloud infrastructure providers to host applications, databases, file storage, backups, and related security or operational services.

subsections.title: 7.7 Social Media and Embedded Content
content: We may embed social content or use social platform integrations that can collect device identifiers, interaction data, and referral information when users interact with those features.

subsections.title: 7.8 Email and Marketing Platforms
content: We may use email delivery or marketing platforms to send transactional communications, service announcements, newsletters, or campaign messages, subject to applicable consent and unsubscribe requirements.

sections.title: 8. Retention and Security
content: We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service, fulfill the purposes described in this policy, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and meet legal, tax, accounting, or regulatory obligations.
We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

subsections.title: 8.1 Fiscal and Accounting Retention
content: Where invoicing, tax, accounting, or fiscal compliance applies, we may retain billing and transaction-related records for the period required by applicable commercial, accounting, or tax law.

subsections.title: 8.2 Profiling and Automated Decision Review
content: If we use profiling, behavioral segmentation, automated scoring, or similar decision-making tools, we review those practices to ensure they are consistent with applicable law and user rights, especially where such tools could materially affect user experience, access, or commercial treatment.

subsections.title: 8.3 Order and Fulfillment Records
content: For physical goods, we may retain order history, billing records, and shipping information for longer periods where required to fulfill contracts, handle returns, support warranties, or comply with commercial and tax recordkeeping requirements.

subsections.title: 8.4 Argentina Security, Retention, and Sensitive Data
content: Where Argentina privacy law applies, we aim to limit internal access to personal information, document reasonable security measures, and retain information only for the period necessary for the stated purposes or applicable legal requirements.
If sensitive data were ever processed, we would seek to do so under a heightened legal basis, with proportionate safeguards and use restrictions tied to the relevant specific purpose.

subsections.title: 9.1 Services Directed to Children
content: If the service is directed to children or knowingly collects information from children, additional notice, parental consent, and data handling safeguards may apply. Review the generated policy carefully to confirm that age-gating, consent, and parental rights language matches actual business practices.

subsections.title: 9.2 General Audience Services
content: The service is intended for a general audience and is not designed to knowingly collect personal information directly from children without appropriate legal basis or parental authorization where required.

sections.title: 10. International Transfers
content: Because the service may rely on global vendors or remote infrastructure, personal information may be processed in countries other than the user's jurisdiction. Where required, we use appropriate contractual, organizational, or technical safeguards for cross-border transfers.

subsections.title: 10.1 Transfers from Argentina
content: If personal data is transferred from Argentina to vendors, infrastructure, or third parties located in other countries, we seek to rely on reasonable legal grounds and safeguards appropriate to the service, the vendor involved, and applicable law.

sections.title: 11. Exercising Privacy Rights
content: Users may submit privacy or data subject requests using the contact methods listed below. We may verify identity before fulfilling access, correction, deletion, portability, or objection requests where legally required.

subsections.title: 11.1 Requests under Law 25.326
content: Where Argentina law applies, requests should ideally identify the data subject, the relationship with the service, and the right the person seeks to exercise. The business aims to respond within reasonable periods and, where applicable, in line with the timing contemplated by local law.

sections.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect legal, operational, or product changes. The latest version should be published with an updated effective date.
